tagline: Renewable fiber-based packaging and biomaterials company in the global bioeconomy
hero_kpi_rationale: Principal performance indicator reflecting the significant cyclical decline (-20%) of the group in 2023 due to lower selling prices and volumes

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales generated by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Revenue declined by 20% in 2023 to €9.4 billion, primarily due to lower selling prices and reduced volumes.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin fell to 3.6% in 2023 from 16.2% in 2022, driven by lower prices, reduced volumes, and higher variable costs.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed within the group.
kpis.description: Stora Enso had 20,822 employees in 2023, reflecting a significant workforce in forest management and industrial production.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating result before non-comparable items and fair value changes.
kpis.description: Adjusted operating income decreased by 81.9% to €342 million in 2023 from €1,891 million in 2022, mainly due to lower prices and volumes as well as increased variable costs.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical assets such as factories or machinery.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.

kpis.name: R&D as % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in revenue.
